subject: Choosing cabinet finishes and handles
hook: Matt, gloss or wood-effect? Pick the finish your household can live with.
ig:
Matt, gloss or wood-effect? Pick the finish your household can live with.

Showrooms are lit perfectly and nobody cooks in them. Your kitchen has children, a dog, a busy hob and a north-facing window. Choose with that in mind:

Matt: calm, forgiving of small scratches, but greasy fingermarks can show near the hob.
Super matt: deep, soft colour with almost no reflection. Wipe, never scrub.
Gloss: bounces light round darker rooms, but shows smears more.
Wood-effect: warm and forgiving of daily marks, with no oiling. It is a finish on engineered board, not solid timber.

Then handles: antique gold warms dark and wood-effect doors, matt black sharpens pale ones, and handleless keeps a run clean.

The best test is cheap: take three samples home and look at them at 8am and 8pm.

Save this for your kitchen plans, and find our bespoke kitchens via the link in bio.
fb:
If you are spending the holidays in someone else's kitchen this year, have a look at their doors. Are the fingerprints obvious? Do the marks show near the hob?

It is the best research you can do before choosing your own finish. Matt is calm and forgiving, super matt gives deep colour but likes a gentle wipe, gloss brightens darker rooms but shows smears, and wood-effect adds warmth and hides everyday marks.

Then the handles: gold, black or handleless.
